headline: Central Bank of Brazil Announces $1 Billion Dollar Repurchase Auctions
summary: Banco Central do Brasil scheduled two foreign exchange line auctions selling up to $1 billion with repurchase commitments. The operations aim to provide liquidity to local foreign exchange markets.
why: Brazil's central bank intervenes in currency markets to smooth volatility in the foreign exchange rate.

impacts.name: Brazilian Real
impacts.why: Direct dollar injections into the local FX market supply short-term foreign currency liquidity.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Central bank foreign currency liquidity auctions directly support domestic FX market stability.
